children.text: I think brotli lives in the node library, and express only reaches through node zlib itself. you can say the door is express but house is node.
From what I can gather, Express 5's body-parser has Brotli decoding enabled by default which would make any endpoint with this middleware vulnerable to this. Am I mistaken?

children.author: bmitch3020
children.text:
CVE-2026-111497 is not limited to nodejs. The brotli decoder is also included in other projects, including curl[0] and git[1].

[0] https://infosec.exchange/@harrysintonen/117489564359709891

[1] https://infosec.exchange/@harrysintonen/117489801970908776
